assets.unusedCaveat: Unused means unreferenced by this design only; no deletion recommendation and no other design files were read.

limitations: A single snapshot checks ID uniqueness and records ID digests; stable IDs across edits require comparing two saved reports.
Image inspection validates the project binary/size/hash contract; it does not decode pixels or prove HTTP/browser display.
Modal game-art detection uses exact known ACE scene/hero asset hashes plus element names; a zero count is not a visual comparison.
Repeated-role differences are diagnostics; partial rows, content variants and clips can be intentional.
No input, focus, contrast, overflow screenshots, original-video equivalence or game API behavior was verified.
npm test was not run: product source was unchanged; product baseline tests and this new UI snapshot audit are separate.
